$comment: v0.28.0 tool surface: protein annotation (#13/#14/#21), format interchange (#10),
Each task pins RENDERED text the tool actually produces, not only 'it ran': the
instability index and its stable/unstable call, the von Heijne cleavage site, the
two coordinate conventions (1-based GFF3 vs 0-based BED is covered offline in
smoke), read placement/orientation in the contig, and allele frequencies with their
CDS effects. The editing task's frequency is a fraction of ALIGNED reads — the
task says so because a model that reports TIDE-style efficiency would be wrong.

tasks.instruction:
Before I express this peptide I want its annotation: which PTM motifs are present, whether there is a low-complexity region, and whether the instability index calls it stable. Use the defaults.

Protein: AANASWAAWGEASTALKAERRASAAEAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA

assertions.note: the low-complexity region at the C-terminus
Guruprasad instability index and its call
the model reports annotation content, not only a count

tasks.instruction:
Does this protein have a cleavable signal peptide? Give the cleavage position, the signal-peptide sequence and any candidate transmembrane segment.

Protein: MALWMRLLPLLALLALWGPDPAAAFVNQHLCGSHLVEALY

assertions.note: the von Heijne score peaks at the preproinsulin cleavage site
the hydropathy run is reported as a candidate, not a topology
